visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a man in black attire wearing a beige baby carrier, standing before a large airport terminal window overlooking a tarmac. A baby in a light-colored outfit looks out the window at an ANA-branded airplane parked outside under bright daylight. (2) A transition shows a sequence of food: a steaming bowl of tonkotsu ramen with vibrant green onions and a platter of pan-fried gyoza. A woman with short brown hair wearing a black-and-white striped shirt holds up a brown paper shopping bag with a red logo in an indoor setting with warm lighting. (3) The scene shifts to a retail store where hands hold a bright yellow souvenir box. Multiple yellow boxes are stacked on shelves. A close-up reveals a round, light-colored pastry split in half, showcasing a dense, sweet bean filling. The woman in the striped shirt is shown tasting the pastry, smiling and giving a thumbs-up gesture. (4) The camera focuses on a store display for 'MENBEI' with red and white packaging. A woman holds a flat, reddish-brown cracker with a visible texture. She takes a bite, looking directly at the camera with an expressive, satisfied face. The background includes various boxes on shelves and a Tom and Jerry collaboration display. (5) A pink box for strawberry-flavored cookies is presented. In a store, a display features fake strawberries next to stacks of pink and white packages. A close-up shows a thick sandwich cookie being broken apart to reveal layers of cream and jam. The woman is seen enjoying the cookie with her eyes closed in a brightly lit kitchen-like setting. (6) A hand holds a small plush toy of a white character wrapped in plastic. A price tag and label with cartoon illustrations are shown. The final shot features the woman, the man, and the baby together indoors; the woman holds up two plushies as they all smile warmly toward the camera.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 上禮拜全家一起去福岡玩. [Slogan]: 日本人最愛買福岡伴手禮 (日本朋友認證). (2) [Subtitle]: 吃了一堆豚骨拉麵. 一口煎餃. (3) [Subtitle]: 還買了一堆伴手禮. (4) [Subtitle]: 今天跟大家分享3個. (5) [Logo]: 博多通りもん (博多饅頭). (6) [Subtitle]: 講到福岡第一個日本人會想到的就是他. (7) [Subtitle]: 走到哪一個店都有他的櫃位. 就知道日本人有多愛. (8) [Subtitle]: 饅頭外皮有濃郁奶香味. 再搭配上甜而不膩的豆沙餡. 超好吃. (9) [Subtitle]: 我老公這次也買了一堆給公司同事. (10) [Logo]: MENBEI. めんぺい (明太子仙貝). (11) [Subtitle]: 在日本無人不知無人不曉. 也是我老公最愛的福岡伴手禮. (12) [Subtitle]: 一片濃縮明太子香和海鮮精華. 有點微辣超涮嘴. (13) [Variety]: (請各位聽聽他有多脆). (14) [Subtitle]: 口味選擇很多, 還有福岡和聯名限定喔. (15) [Logo]: PRESS BUTTER SAND あまおう苺 (甘王草莓焦糖奶油口味). (16) [Subtitle]: 他們家的夾心餅乾不用多說, 就是超好吃. (17) [Subtitle]: 九州限定口味是用福岡生產的甘王草莓製作. (18) [Subtitle]: 濃郁內餡搭配酥脆餅乾. 真的忍不住一口接一口. (19) [Subtitle]: 我當天買時, 還有桃子和檸檬口味喔. (20) [Subtitle]: 另外還有很多吉伊卡哇的福岡限定. [Subtitle]: 我這次就買了一隻抱著明太子的吉伊給我朋友. (21) [Subtitle]: 我是在東京育兒的RU醬, 追蹤我看更多日本生活.
